data.name: Off The Record: The Art of Deception Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Another stunning game from Eipix Entertainment, creators of the Amaranthine Voyage and Sea of Lies series!

A lost masterpiece has just resurfaced in Austria, and Lisa Steiner, the artist in charge of restoring it, won’t talk to anyone in the media… except you. But when you arrive to interview her, Lisa runs away without explanation. Now you must decipher the secret clues hidden in her paintings to track her down and get your story. Lisa’s life – and yours – may depend on it. Dive into a gorgeous, artistic world as you uncover the truth. Just be careful – deception is a deadly art in this thrilling Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version. The Collector’s Edition includes:

Uncover another dangerous plot in the bonus game.
Collect souvenirs, letters, and achievements!
Unlock extras, including videos, wallpapers, and original music.
Access the Strategy Guide.

reviews.review:
Off The Record: The Art of Deception is the third game in the series. The first thing you'll notice is the beautiful artwork, and this game is about art. A young artist, Lisa Steiner, is forced to forge a famous painting and you, as a journalist will go into an adventure to cover the story and to save the artist who got kidnapped. The story is mediocre but what will keep you playing is to find out who is the one behind all of this. The bonus chapter wasn't bad as it introduced a new character and a new side story.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1873688816

The hidden objects scenes are unique and vary between the list of items, silhouette, riddles, and find x amount of an item. The puzzles were fun, they vary in difficulty but if you ever got stuck in one of them, there is an integrated guide you can check any time. I liked the map design, and luckily there is a fast traveling function in it which minimizes the backtracking in the game.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1873688544

What I found tricky is the Collectible items which I missed a couple of them, however, by the end of the game, you'll unlock an extra feature that will allow you to open the scenes and collect all the items you forgot to pick, such as Souvenir, letters, and the paint tubes. All of these items give you an in-game achievement if you collect them.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1873694925

The voice-overs wasn't the best, but the soundtracks are really nice. You can also download them from the extra menu.

Pros:
+Beautiful visuals and locations design.
+Good Soundtracks.
+Well drawn hidden objects scenes.
+Variety of original puzzles.

Cons
-Mediocre story.
-Mediocre voice-overs.
-No Journal.
-No steam achievements.

If you enjoy Hidden objects adventure games, better get it and enjoy playing it with a discount.
